 Gold Futures Rise 1% to Rs 1.41 Lakh Amid Firm Global Trends
 By Rediff Money Desk , New Delhi 
 1 Minute Read Listen to Article 
 Share:     
 Nov 11, 2026 15:13
 x 
 Gold futures surged nearly 1% to Rs 1.41 lakh/10gm on MCX, tracking strong global trends. December delivery contract climbed Rs 1,025. Key Points
 Gold futures rose nearly 1% to Rs 1.41 lakh per 10 grams on Wednesday.
 The increase was driven by firm trends in international markets.
 On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the December delivery contract climbed Rs 1,025.
 Globally, Comex gold futures also rose by nearly 1% to USD 4,064.20 per ounce.
 New Delhi, Nov 11 (PTI) Gold prices rose nearly 1 per cent to Rs 1.41 lakh per 10 grams in futures trade on Wednesday, tracking firm trends in the international markets.
 On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the yellow metal contract for December delivery climbed Rs 1,025, or 0.73 per cent, to Rs 1,41,550 per 10 grams in a business turnover of 16,203 lots.
 The contract closed at Rs 1,40,525 per 10 grams on Tuesday.
 Commodities markets were closed on Tuesday in the morning session on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
 In global markets, Comex gold futures for December delivery rose USD 34, or nearly 1 per cent, to USD 4,064.20 per ounce in New York. -->

 New Delhi, Nov 11 (PTI) Gold prices rose nearly 1 per cent to Rs 1.41 lakh per 10 grams in futures trade on Wednesday, tracking firm trends in the international markets.
 On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the yellow metal contract for December delivery climbed Rs 1,025, or 0.73 per cent, to Rs 1,41,550 per 10 grams in a business turnover of 16,203 lots.
 The contract closed at Rs 1,40,525 per 10 grams on Tuesday.
 Commodities markets were closed on Tuesday in the morning session on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
 In global markets, Comex gold futures for December delivery rose USD 34, or nearly 1 per cent, to USD 4,064.20 per ounce in New York.
